```python
import builtins
import importlib.util
import inspect
import os
import types
import sys
import tempfile

import pytest

from pysnooper.tracer import get_path_and_source_from_frame, UnavailableSource


def _create_module_with_function(tmp_path, filename, code):
    """Create a temporary module file and import it."""
    file_path = tmp_path / filename
    file_path.write_text(code, encoding="utf-8")
    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("temp_module", str(file_path))
    module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
    sys.modules["temp_module"] = module
    spec.loader.exec_module(module)
    return module, file_path


def test_get_path_and_source_from_frame_reads_file(tmp_path):
    """Normal case: source read from a real file."""
    code = "def foo():\n    return 42\n"
    module, file_path = _create_module_with_function(tmp_path, "foo.py", code)
    func = module.foo
    frame = inspect.currentframe()
    # Move to the frame of the function call
    while frame and frame.f_code.co_name != "foo":
        frame = frame.f_back
    assert frame is not None
    file_name, source = get_path_and_source_from_frame(frame)
    assert file_name == str(file_path)
    assert source == ["def foo():", "    return 42"]


def test_get_path_and_source_from_frame_decodes_bytes(tmp_path):
    """Source read as bytes should be decoded correctly."""
    # Write a file with a coding cookie
    code_bytes = b"#!/usr/bin/env python\n# -*- coding: latin-1 -*-\nprint('café')\n"
    file_path = tmp_path / "latin.py"
    file_path.write_bytes(code_bytes)
    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("latin_module", str(file_path))
    module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
    sys.modules["latin_module"] = module
    spec.loader.exec_module(module)
    func = module.__dict__.get("__main__") or module
    frame = inspect.currentframe()
    while frame and frame.f_code.co_name != "__main__":
        frame = frame.f_back
    assert frame is not None
    file_name, source = get_path_and_source_from_frame(frame)
    assert file_name == str(file_path)
    # The source should be decoded using latin-1
    assert source == ["#!/usr/bin/env python", "# -*- coding: latin-1 -*-", "print('café')"]


def test_get_path_and_source_from_frame_unavailable_source(tmp_path):
    """When the file cannot be read, UnavailableSource is returned."""
    # Create a temporary file and delete it before calling the function
    file_path = tmp_path / "missing.py"
    file_path.write_text("def missing(): pass\n", encoding="utf-8")
    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("missing_module", str(file_path))
    module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
    sys.modules["missing_module"] = module
    spec.loader.exec_module(module)
    # Delete the file to simulate missing source
    file_path.unlink()
    func = module.missing
    frame = inspect.currentframe()
    while frame and frame.f_code.co_name != "missing":
        frame = frame.f_back
    assert frame is not None
    file_name, source = get_path_and_source_from_frame(frame)
    assert file_name == str(file_path)
    # The source should be an instance of UnavailableSource
    assert isinstance(source[0], str)
    assert source[0] == "SOURCE IS UNAVAILABLE"
```
